# Pooja Verma

> AI developer and machine learning researcher in Kamloops, British Columbia,
> Canada, and a computing science student at Thompson Rivers University (TRU).
> She builds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, evaluates and
> fine-tunes large language models, trains machine learning models for
> research, and ships full-stack and data products. Open to AI development
> projects, applied ML research, grant-funded work and collaborations across
> British Columbia and Canada.

Site: https://www.poojaverma.ca
Last updated: September 2026

## Contact her for
- AI and machine learning development in Kamloops, the BC Interior, British
  Columbia or anywhere in Canada, in person or remote.
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM evaluation, prompt and benchmark
  design, and RLHF data work.
- Applied ML research, including grant-funded and university research at
  Thompson Rivers University (UREAP, sustainability grants, Mitacs).
- Full-stack web products, data pipelines and Salesforce or Power Platform
  automation.
- Email: pooja32verma@gmail.com

## Experience
- Junior Research Intern, Mitacs Business Strategy Internship, PataBid
  (January to September 2026): owned a high-performance PDF rendering engine
  for a construction estimating platform and the pipelines behind automated
  stamp and take-off detection.
- Undergraduate Student Researcher, TRU Sustainability Research Grant (April
  2026 to present): AI-driven post-wildfire ecosystem recovery.
- Generative AI Data Specialist, Outlier (October 2025 to present): designs
  coding benchmarks and multi-turn reasoning prompts used to fine-tune frontier
  LLMs through RLHF, and red-teams reasoning for hallucination resistance.
  Previously Tier-3 Programmer Analyst there (2024 to 2025).
- Research Assistant, TRU (May to July 2025): built a RAG study assistant used
  by 3,000+ students, improving answer relevance by 40%.
- UREAP Undergraduate Researcher, TRU (April to November 2025): diabetic
  retinopathy detection from fundus images, published as first author.
- Programmer Analyst Co-op, BC Lottery Corporation (May 2024 to January 2025):
  Salesforce (Apex, LWC) and Power Platform work for 4,000+ retailers and an
  employee check-in platform for 1,000+ staff; cut manual licensing work 30%.
- Teaching Assistant (three terms) and Research Coach at TRU, mentoring 150+
  students in Python, Java, data structures, web development and research
  methods.

## Research and awards
- AI-Driven Post-Wildfire Ecosystem Recovery. TRU Student Sustainability
  Research Grant ($2,500). LightGBM at 0.707 weighted F1 over six merged
  environmental datasets; presented at the TRU Sustainability Conference.
- Paper (first author): "Optimized Deep Learning Framework for Diabetic
  Retinopathy Detection and Classification Using Fundus Imaging", Inspire
  Health Journal 1(1), 42-62, January 2026, with Ghazanfar Latif, Jaspreet
  Kaur and Mohsin Butt. Fused AlexNet and Swin Transformer features; 98.2%
  accuracy on APTOS 2019. https://doi.org/10.65718/inspireHealth.2026.2005
  Funded by a UREAP Research Award ($6,000).

## Skills
- Machine learning: PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, Optuna,
  SMOTE, RAG systems, RLHF, pandas, NumPy, SciPy.
- AI products: TypeSafe Jev typed decision APIs (probabilistic yes/no, choice
  and score questions), LLM evaluation, Gemini API, Web Speech API.
- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, Apex, SQL, MATLAB.
- Web and enterprise: React, Next.js, Node.js, Lightning Web Components, REST
  APIs, Salesforce, SOQL, Power Apps, Power BI.
- Data and tools: Snowflake, Oracle, Matillion, Git, GitHub Actions, LaTeX.

## Projects (case studies with screenshots and source links)
- [After Fire](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/after-fire): interactive
  atlas of post-wildfire recovery in BC's Thompson-Okanagan; 2,600 burned
  sites, 6 open datasets, XGBoost with SHAP, Next.js, React Three Fiber,
  MapLibre.
- [ReelMind](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/reelmind): Netflix-style movie
  recommender built on TypeSafe's Jev decision model; three typed requests,
  about 400 ms and $0.0006 per recommendation, every pick explained.
- [Pulse](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/pulse): live sales-call coaching;
  Jev answers 12 typed questions after every sentence (median 230 ms).
- [Tidal](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/tidal): IT and support ticket
  routing with confidence-gated human review; 96.9% team accuracy on 96
  labelled tickets.
- [Shortlist](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/shortlist): resume screening
  where every criterion is a typed question; new criteria re-score 40 resumes
  in about a second.
- [Wildwood](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/wildwood): voice-controlled
  first-person survival game in the browser (Three.js, React Three Fiber);
  sentences become game actions through Jev in about 115 ms.
- [Tadka](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/tadka): installable mobile app for
  Indian home cooking; one Jev request scores 68 dishes against a craving.
- [Keystroke Dynamics](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/keystroke-dynamics):
  a typing simulator built from 99 real typists, tested against Random Forest,
  Gradient Boosting and AdaBoost detectors of synthetic typing; Python,
  scikit-learn, Flask.
- [Sprint Ticket Master](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/sprint-ticket-master):
  Excel task lists turned into sprint tickets by Google Gemini; Next.js,
  SheetJS.
- [Schedulo](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/schedulo): real-time shift
  scheduler with swaps, a drag-and-drop store calendar and analytics; React,
  Firebase Firestore.
- [Workout Calorie Prediction](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/workout-calories-ml):
  machine-learning study of 20,000 workout sessions, including an audit of a
  leaked feature; scikit-learn.
- [Solo Ascend](https://www.poojaverma.ca/projects/solo-ascend): gamified
  habit tracker with XP, levels and ranks; React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
